title: Coscribe
description: Research writing workspace that interviews authors, structures research plans and drafts from verified source material. Supports citation evidence checks, literature discovery, reference management, section editing, reviewer-style critique and PDF/DOCX/LaTeX exports.
features: Interview researchers and shape study designs into approvable outlines
Ingest papers and discover literature through academic indexes
Draft sections from verified source material with citation-support checks
Review drafts and export venue-ready PDF, DOCX or LaTeX
workflow: Collect research notes, references and writing examples
Structure the study through guided interviews
Draft and review one section at a time
Verify citations and export to publication templates
